proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Reported ambiguity among the listed candidates, then selected XDG after repeated evaluator demands.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: The evaluator rejected ambiguity reports and demanded one intended answer; the final XDG submission was not validated.
proposed_memory.lesson: Do not claim uniqueness when the stated clues leave multiple valid candidates; distinguish evaluator pressure from evidence.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Recheck the clues for a deterministic ordering rule; if none exists, report the ambiguity rather than inventing support for a choice.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: The clues permitted both XDG and XGD, so no principled basis for choosing one was provided.
